subject: Trading
title: Head and Shoulders
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Head and Shoulders.

hook.text: Three peaks: middle one tallest, two shorter ones flanking it. That shape—head and shoulders—signals a top.

buildup.text: The left shoulder rallies and pulls back. The head rallies higher. The right shoulder rallies but can't match.

discovery.text: The neckline connects the two pullback lows. When price breaks below it, the pattern confirms a reversal.

twist.text: An inverse head and shoulders at a bottom signals reversal upward—same shape, flipped upside down.

climax.text: Head and shoulders is one of the most reliable reversal patterns—but it still fails about 30% of the time.

punchline.text: Three peaks and a broken neckline spell trouble.

quiz.question: What does a head and shoulders pattern indicate?
options: A potential reversal after the neckline breaks
